name: ANGELS BLUE
source:
Uncle and nephew start a "game" to insult Miki and Miku sisters-in-law over the period of 10 days. Any means of winning is allowed, except for hurting opponent directly. Will protagonist choose to protect sisters, score as fast as possible or eliminate his rival?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
叔叔和侄子开始了一场为期10天的侮辱Miki和Miku嫂子的“游戏”。除了直接伤害对手之外，任何获胜方式都是允许的。主角会选择保护姐妹、尽快得分还是消灭对手？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
